semiconductor_relevance: High — Nichias Corporation provides specialized materials that are critical for insulation and cleanliness in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nichias Corporation offers a range of inorganic insulation materials and high-performance rubber products that are essential for maintaining cleanliness and safety in semiconductor applications. Their products include insulation jackets for heating and specialized fluororesin tubes that enhance chemical resistance and fire safety.
capabilities: Inorganic insulation materials for detachable pipe heating
High-performance rubber products for sealing and cleanliness
Fluororesin tubes with chemical and heat resistance
SolventClean® technology for VOC exhaust gas treatment
